
### exercise: 802.11b distance  {.smaller}


* 50 $\mu s$ minimum interframe spacing
* 10 $\mu s$ slots after that if contention
* speed of light propogation
* need to detect channel quiet this time minimum before transmitting
* 11Mbps max bitrate; $\sim$288 minimum frame size 
<hr class="vspace" />
* exercise: 50 $\mu s$ includes time for ACK --- maximum distance before too little?
* exercise: what distance before carrier sense not useful?


### 802.11b distance  {.smaller}


* 50 $\mu s$ around 15000 metres for signals in IFS 

   * implies max distance for ACKs not being squashed of 7500 meteres

* 10 $\mu s$ means signal goes approx. 3000 metres 

   * distance where we won't detect transmission in previous slot accurately
   * won't be sufficient to have chosen different retransmission slots

* 288 bit frame/11 Mbit approx. 27 microsec to transmit


### very long-distance wifi  {.smaller}


* people have done very long distance wifi 

   * parabolic dishes, more recent versions than 802.11b

* increase ACK timeouts and/or turn off ACKs 
<hr class="vspace" />
* Wifi records are point-to-point with very directional antennas
